ex.en: We booked two adjoining rooms so the children could stay nearby.
ex.zh: 我们订了两间相邻的房间，方便孩子住在旁边。

words.note: adjoin 是动词；日常更常用形容词 adjoining，表「毗邻的」。

ex.en: Scientists still cannot explain how the universe began.
ex.zh: 科学家仍无法解释宇宙是如何起源的。

words.note: universe 表「宇宙」时须加 the，用单数形式。

ex.en: She inherited the old farm from her grandparents.
ex.zh: 她从祖父母那里继承了这座老农场。

words.note: inherit 可直接接财产或特征，from 引出原主；名词为 inheritance。

ex.en: The proposal was passed by an overwhelming majority.
ex.zh: 该提案以压倒性多数获得通过。

words.note: overwhelming 常修饰 majority、evidence，语气很强。

ex.en: It is difficult to interpret these results without more data.
ex.zh: 没有更多数据，很难解读这些结果。

words.note: interpret 兼有「解释」和「口译」两义；名词为 interpretation。

ex.en: This custom is peculiar to the fishing villages along the coast.
ex.zh: 这一习俗是沿海渔村所特有的。

words.note: be peculiar to 表「为…所特有」；与 strange 近义但更书面。

ex.en: Learning idioms helps students understand how native speakers really talk.
ex.zh: 学习习语有助于学生理解母语者的真实说法。

words.note: idiom 是可数名词，指固定习语；注意别与 idiot(傻瓜) 混淆。

ex.en: The young diplomat was sent to Paris to represent his country.
ex.zh: 这位年轻外交官被派往巴黎代表本国。

words.note: diplomat 指外交官；diplomatic 意为「外交的」或「圆通的」。

ex.en: She gave her mother a hug before boarding the plane.
ex.zh: 登机前她拥抱了母亲。

words.note: 名词常用 give sb a hug；动词直接接人，如 hug her mother。

ex.en: The government granted the company a licence to build the factory.
ex.zh: 政府批准该公司建厂。

words.note: take ... for granted 是固定短语，意为「想当然」。

ex.en: Years of swimming gave him a lean, muscular body.
ex.zh: 多年游泳使他身材精瘦而肌肉发达。

words.note: muscular 由 muscle 加 -ar 构成，表「肌肉的、强壮的」。

ex.en: Her eyes sparkled with excitement when she opened the gift.
ex.zh: 她拆开礼物时，眼睛闪着兴奋的光。

words.note: sparkle 多指星光、眼睛「闪烁」；glitter 多指金属反光。

ex.en: He hummed a tune while washing the dishes.
ex.zh: 他一边洗碗一边哼着曲子。

words.note: hum 可指人「哼歌」，也指机器或人群「嗡嗡作响」。

ex.en: Rice is a staple food for more than half the world's population.
ex.zh: 大米是世界一半以上人口的主食。

words.note: staple 作形容词指「主要的」，作名词指「主食、主要产品」。

ex.en: Students can get a ten per cent discount on all books.
ex.zh: 学生购买所有图书可享九折优惠。

words.note: 「打几折」用 at a discount；折扣大小说 a 10% discount。

ex.en: Workers are constructing a new bridge across the river.
ex.zh: 工人们正在河上新建一座桥。

words.note: construct 比 build 正式；名词 construction 也指「建筑物」。

ex.en: The author receives a small royalty on every copy sold.
ex.zh: 每卖出一本书，作者都能得到少量版税。

words.note: royalty 指「版税」时常用复数 royalties；也指「王族」。

ex.en: The old factory has been converted into a museum.
ex.zh: 这座旧工厂已被改造成博物馆。

words.note: convert 常与 into 搭配，名词是 conversion。

ex.en: He made several attempts to contact her but failed.
ex.zh: 他几次尝试联系她，都失败了。

words.note: 名词用 make an attempt to do；动词说 attempt to do。

ex.en: There has always been fierce rivalry between the two companies.
ex.zh: 这两家公司之间一直竞争激烈。

words.note: rivalry 来自 rival(对手)，表示「…之间」用 between。

ex.en: She relished every moment of her first trip abroad.
ex.zh: 她非常享受第一次出国旅行的每一刻。

words.note: relish 后接名词或动名词，不接不定式。

ex.en: The office was lit by harsh fluorescent lights.
ex.zh: 办公室里的荧光灯亮得刺眼。

words.note: fluorescent 常搭配 light、lamp、tube，指荧光灯管。

ex.en: The company set up a new division to handle online sales.
ex.zh: 公司新设了一个部门负责网上销售。

words.note: division 可指部门、分割、除法；动词为 divide。

ex.en: His knowledge of the subject is superficial at best.
ex.zh: 他对这门学科的了解充其量是肤浅的。

words.note: super-(上)+fic(面) 构成「表面的」；说人浅薄含贬义。

ex.en: She was promoted to a senior executive position last year.
ex.zh: 她去年升任高级管理职位。

words.note: executive 作名词指「高管」，作形容词指「执行的、行政的」。

ex.en: The ship's navigation system failed during the storm.
ex.zh: 暴风雨中船上的导航系统失灵了。

words.note: navigation 来自 navigate；navigable 指河流「可通航的」。

ex.en: The snow melted quickly in the warm spring sunshine.
ex.zh: 积雪在温暖的春光中很快融化。

words.note: melt 可及物也可不及物；melt away 常指情绪或人群消散。

ex.en: He stalked out of the meeting without saying a word.
ex.zh: 他一言不发，愤然离开会场。

words.note: stalk 作名词指「茎、秆」，作动词指「跟踪」或「大步走」。

ex.en: Some students prefer to study alone, whereas others learn better in groups.
ex.zh: 有些学生喜欢独自学习，而另一些人小组学习效果更好。

words.note: whereas 表前后对比，多用于书面语，前一分句后用逗号。

ex.en: We pitched our tent by the lake and stayed there two nights.
ex.zh: 我们在湖边搭起帐篷，住了两晚。

words.note: pitch 多义：搭帐篷、投掷、音高、球场、沥青，靠语境判断。
